## Part 3: Basic Analysis (5 points)

### 3.1 Estimate Treatment Effect

We'll estimate the effect of `treatment` on `outcome_score` using OLS with robust standard errors:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Fit model with robust SEs
model <- lm_robust(outcome_score ~ treatment, data = data)

# View results
tidy(model)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
         term estimate std.error statistic      p.value  conf.low conf.high df
1 (Intercept)   76.432 0.9863691 77.488234 4.407562e-52 74.448772  78.41523 48
2   treatment   11.388 1.4128661  8.060212 1.786208e-10  8.547242  14.22876 48
        outcome
1 outcome_score
2 outcome_score
```


:::
:::


### 3.2 Interpret Results

**Question:** What is the estimated treatment effect? Is it statistically significant at the 5% level?

**Your answer:** [Write your answer here]

### 3.3 Add Covariates

Now estimate the model controlling for baseline score:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Model with covariate
model_adj <- lm_robust(outcome_score ~ treatment + baseline_score, data = data)

# View results
tidy(model_adj)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

## Part 4: Visualization (5 points)

### 4.1 Treatment Effect Plot

Create a boxplot comparing outcomes by treatment status:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(treatment), y = outcome_score, fill = factor(treatment))) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#4BACC6", "1" = "#9BBB59"),
                    labels = c("Control", "Treatment")) +
  labs(
    title = "Treatment Effect on Outcome",
    x = "Treatment Status",
    y = "Outcome Score",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![Outcome by Treatment Status](lab-0-setup_files/figure-html/boxplot-1.png){fig-alt='Boxplot showing outcome distribution for treatment and control groups' width=672}
:::
:::


### 4.2 Scatter Plot with Regression Line


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data, aes(x = baseline_score, y = outcome_score, color = factor(treatment))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "#4BACC6", "1" = "#9BBB59"),
                     labels = c("Control", "Treatment")) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline vs Outcome by Treatment Status",
    x = "Baseline Score",
    y = "Outcome Score",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
`geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
```


:::
